newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SBI 96/97 1st half net up 179 pct.
newsitem.headline: India's SBI 96/97 1st half net up 179 pct.

text.p: India's largest commercial bank State Bank of India (SBI) on Thursday said its net profit for the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) rose sharply to 6.41 billion rupees against 2.3 billion in the year-ago period.
The bank said its annualised earnings per share for the year, after the issue of global depositary receipts (GDR) earlier this year, stood at 24.35 rupees.
SBI said its first half deposits rose 9.65 percent to 955.73 billion rupees and its first half advances fell 4.13 percent to 496.72 billion rupees.
